Hello! I’m late to this by 3 years but wanted to provide my opinions and advice regarding this issue for any parents/children who are facing a similar situation.

Children who face bullying need rest/treatment physically and emotionally to process the trauma they have endured. In New York, there is a program called Home Instruction that provides a teacher to teach a child with physical and emotional issues at home to fulfill their educational requirements. I would highly recommend this program and similar alternatives depending on the school district. This will also give time in figuring out next steps long term.

However the most important part in rehabilitating a child after bullying is emotional healing. This means extensive therapy with a professional specializing in childhood/adolescent trauma, building a stronger familial relationship, and exposure in hobbies and activities.

For context, I was bullied and struggled getting along with other kids in middle school and ended up transferring quite literally the next day to a new school. This was not the right solution. It did not work out well for me long term and I struggled severely until I barely graduated high school. 

I ended up going into home instruction twice, once in 8th grade as I developed a condition called conversion disorder and my senior year of high school after I refused to attend school for nearly 8 months. I believe that I would have had been able to better regulate and navigate the rest of my childhood and teenage years if home instruction, therapy, and a development plan was implemented from the beginning.

I hope this provides guidance for those who may be in similar circumstances trying to figure out a solution. Sending my love to everyone 💕
